light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a coworker with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the room behind stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, daylight from the window and a warm ceiling bulb. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores and uneven tone; hair with stray curls; the khaki work shirt with real creases. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld video filmed by a coworker with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural rough hands; he moves naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Lugar número dos. Los caños. Vamos a la cocina. Abro el mueble del fregadero. Saco los productos de limpieza.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, opens the wooden cabinet doors under the sink, takes out bottles of cleaning products and puts them on the floor, kneels with the flashlight. daylight from the window and a warm ceiling bulb. He wears the same light khaki short-sleeve two-pocket work shirt with clear safety glasses pushed up on his forehead the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: Y con la linterna, miro donde el caño entra a la pared. ¿Ves esto? Alrededor del caño, el agujero que hizo el plomero es mucho más grande que el caño.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, leans into the cabinet, the flashlight lighting the back wall where the gray drain pipe goes into the wall through a ragged hole much bigger than the pipe. daylight from the window and a warm ceiling bulb. He wears the same light khaki short-sleeve two-pocket work shirt with clear safety glasses pushed up on his forehead the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: Pruebo la moneda. Pasa sobrada. Me pongo los guantes.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, pushes a small silver coin about 18 millimeters wide through the gap beside the pipe, it falls through; he takes a pair of gray work gloves and pulls them on. daylight from the window and a warm ceiling bulb. He wears the same light khaki short-sleeve two-pocket work shirt with clear safety glasses pushed up on his forehead the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: Arranco un pedazo de lana de acero, lo enrollo como una salchicha, y lo empujo con el destornillador hasta el fondo del hueco. Apretado. Que no quede flojo.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, tears a piece off a pad of coarse gray steel wool, rolls it into a thick sausage and pushes it into the gap around the pipe with a flathead screwdriver, pressing hard. daylight from the window and a warm ceiling bulb. He wears the same light khaki short-sleeve two-pocket work shirt with clear safety glasses pushed up on his forehead the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: Sigo metiendo hasta que ya no entra más. Si queda suelto, el ratón lo jala con los dientes y lo saca. Y encima, la espuma.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, keeps stuffing more steel wool with the screwdriver until the gap is packed tight, then tugs at it with his fingers to show it does not come out. daylight from the window and a warm ceiling bulb. He wears the same light khaki short-sleeve two-pocket work shirt with clear safety glasses pushed up on his forehead the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: Poca. Agito la lata, y un cordón fino alrededor. Crece sola, el doble. Si pones mucha, se sale por todos lados. Lo mismo detrás del refrigerador,
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, shakes the yellow spray can of polyurethane foam and sprays a thin bead around the steel wool; the pale yellow foam swells slowly. daylight from the window and a warm ceiling bulb. He wears the same light khaki short-sleeve two-pocket work shirt with clear safety glasses pushed up on his forehead the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: donde entra el caño del agua. Jorge me ayuda a correrlo. Y mira lo que está aquí atrás. La tapita de ácido bórico de la primera visita, la de las cucarachas.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, stands up and with Jorge pulls the old white refrigerator out from the wall; behind it, the wall with a water pipe hole and dust on the floor. daylight from the window and a warm ceiling bulb. He wears the same light khaki short-sleeve two-pocket work shirt with clear safety glasses pushed up on his forehead the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: Sigue en su lugar, cerrada, donde ni los chicos ni Bruno llegan. Eso no se toca.
